abricate-card@@@card~~~PFM-4~~~JACOMR010000005.1:4634-5396~~~carbapenem PFM-4 (BioF) is a class B2 metallo-beta-lactamase first identified in Pseudomonas. It belongs to the PFM-like beta-lactamase gene family. It confers resistance to carbapenems and some cephalosporins.

abricate-card@@@card~~~PJM-1~~~NG_080789.1:100-1006~~~carbapenem;cephalosporin;penicillin_beta-lactam PJM-1 is a chromosomally-encoded subclass B3 metallo-beta-lactamase found in P. japonensis confering resistance to a range of antibiotics including ampicillin, cefalotin, and cefoxitin.

abricate-card@@@card~~~PNGM-1~~~MF445022.1:0-1161~~~carbapenem;cephalosporin;penicillin_beta-lactam PNGM-1 is a subclass B3 metallo-beta-lactamase first identified from a deep-sea sediment meta-genome.
